Duties Description NYSIF’s Treasury Department is seeking an Intern to assist with the following:

• Update and track receipts and responses for certain medical cost recoveries.
• Review a shared mailbox and take action depending on the type of item.
• Review spreadsheets and identify items that need further action.
• Add data to spreadsheets
• Treasury data analysis and reporting as required

Minimum Qualifications Minimum Qualifications:
• Candidates must possess education and/or work experience in date entry, data cleaning, and statistical analysis.
• Be actively enrolled in a New York State college, university, or graduate program, or be a resident of New York State, attending a college, university, or graduate program outside of New York State.
• Have completed a minimum of two (2) years as a student at a degree-granting two or four-year college or university (completion of two year's worth of academic credits over a longer period may qualify part-time students for participation in the program).
• Have a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0, or the letter grade equivalent
• Must be able to work at least 10 hours per week; full-time winter break hours preferred. Internships may extend into the following spring depending on availability.

Please be advised that the New York State Insurance Fund (NYSIF) does not offer sponsorship for employment visas to employees or potential employees. Candidates sponsored for employment by an organization should be aware of their sponsorship status and the relevant expiration date(s) of that sponsorship before applying to this position. NYSIF is not currently enrolled in eVerify, which is a requirement for certain types of employment verifications.

Additional Comments Please note, the official Civil Service title for this position is: Student Assistant.

Fringe Benefits:
• Competitive compensation
• Future career growth potential
• Open and supportive team-based environment
• Plentiful vacation, personal, and sick time off
• Paid state and federal holidays
• Affordable health insurance plans
• Dental and vision benefits provided at no additional cost
• Retirement options
• Public Student Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)
• Possibility of telecommuting, flextime, and Alternative Work Schedules (AWS)
